name: rac3/pal
about: Up Your Arsenal, PAL (SCES-524.56), rac3-decomp's primary release: tools/check.py compiles the candidate in the full build's context with the function's own flags (config/<target>/localdecomp_flags.txt, then text_parts.txt) and keeps the object. The program is $UYA_TARGET: frontbin (the default), boot_elf or i5bootn; the levels are not covered yet.
notes: check.py's MATCH is both the compile's verdict and the checker's: no second run.
